prompt: Origin: procedural texture drawn in Python (numpy, PIL) for the Station premium side study; no source image, no generator.
method: Tileable RGBA overlay for thick Edmondson card: wrap-around Gaussian tooth (sigma 0.55 px, 50%), a faint mottle (sigma 30 px, 20%) and 420 short fibres (4 to 12 px, every direction, two in three lighter than the card) at 40%. Negative values are a warm umber, positive values card white; alpha is the magnitude, capped at 13 of 255, so the stock reads as fine fibre under the type and never lowers the ink contrast measurably.
script: design-system/art/metal_textures.py (station_fibre; first drawn by the study's make_station_textures.py, reproduced bit for bit)
usedBy: library.css, Station metal finish (O14), and the study explore/premium-station.css: every ticket surface (person cards, the cover and result plates, the stamped ticket, the next line, the week's lean cards), drawn at 256 px over the ticket colour.
